prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-stylized cinematic portrait of an adult subject in side profile, head tilted back and eyes closed, with a minimal calm expression. Use a deep-red monochrome background and a black high-neck silhouette that blends into shadow. A glowing neon-red light strip traces from the nose bridge to the ear, while a second strip wraps around the neck, creating a futuristic cyberpunk visual language. High-contrast studio lighting, dramatic shadows, sharp facial contours, natural skin texture, minimalist composition, bold red palette, and moody surreal editorial fashion atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, text, logo
